scratch/design.md item 18 is accepted: training_jobs returns only TrainingJobs and eval_jobs only EvalJobs (or RunRequests of them); anything else is refused naming the declaration and its type. It supersedes "declarations return list[Job]" in item 17 and the standalone-eval example in item 9. Plain Job(command=...) stays launchable from Python only; the upgrade note covers converting command jobs in experiment files.
